# Workflow inventory

Backend CI builds the pinned Linux image and executes its existing SDK/Runtime/plugin qualification commands.
`CI_DEBIAN_MIRROR` and `CI_DEBIAN_SECURITY_MIRROR` repository variables select archive endpoints; their defaults are the upstream Debian HTTPS archives.
The build passes them through the Dockerfile's existing `DEBIAN_MIRROR` and `DEBIAN_SECURITY_MIRROR` arguments.

| File | Pos | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `ci-backend.yml` | Backend build check | Build linux/amd64 with configured archive transport and image qualification. |
| `ci-frontend.yml` | Frontend build check | Validate the current Node/Corepack/pnpm frontend build. |
| `deploy-backend.yml` | Backend release workflow | Own the existing backend deployment procedure. |
| `deploy-frontend.yml` | Frontend release workflow | Own the existing frontend deployment procedure. |
